```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
print(billboard)
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarize(
    earliest_date = min(date.entered),
    latest_date = max(date.entered)
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "week", values_to = "ranking") |>
  summarize(
    missing = sum(is.na(ranking)),
    present = sum(!is.na(ranking)),
    .by = week
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    wk1:wk76,
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

ggplot(
  billboard_long,
  aes(week, rank, group = interaction(artist, track))
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_y_reverse()
```
